commits_data.message:
epan: Unsigned offsets for tvb_get_string_[time,bytes]

This requires changing the proto_tree_add_bytes_item and _time_item
functions too. Luckily nothing in the repository uses the return
pointer in those, nor negative offsets nor lengths.

Also use the newer find API calls in the UCP dissector.
